notes.title: A New Update for Detached is here!
notes.content:
[h2]We are over the moon to announce that a brand-new update for ​​​[i]Detached[/i]​​​ is now available! [/h2]

[previewyoutube=5t8MRGsebK8;full][/previewyoutube]

This isn’t just any update—it’s a labour of love for [b]one of our very first projects[/b], a game that holds [b]a special place in our hearts [/b]💙

When we first launched [i]Detached[/i], we set out to create an[b] unforgettable zero-gravity adventure[/b], immersing players in the vastness of space. Over the years, technology has evolved, and we felt it was time to [b]revisit this cosmic journey and bring it up to speed with the latest advancements.[/b]

[h2]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h2]

[h3][b]✨ Expanded Headset Compatibility[/b][/h3]
We’ve opened the airlocks to welcome more players aboard! Detached now supports a wider range of headsets, so even more space explorers can experience the thrill of navigating the cosmos.
👉 The game supports now Oculus Quest 2/3, Pico 4 Pro/Ultra, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.
[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) is no longer supported due to compatibility issues with the latest Windows 10 and Windows 11 updates.

[h3][b]✨ Updated Default Control Scheme[/b][/h3]
Piloting your ship has never felt smoother. We’ve fine-tuned the controls to ensure they’re perfectly aligned with the capabilities of the latest headsets.
👉 Improved FXP control scheme for Oculus Quest 2/3, Valve Index, and Pico 4 Pro/Ultra. ​​

[h3][b]✨ Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements[/b][/h3]
We’ve patched up some cracks in the hull to ensure your journey through the void is as seamless as possible.
👉 Resolved a crash issue caused by OpenSSL 1.0.2 in Unreal Engine 4.19 on Intel 10th Gen+ processors. The game now uses the updated fix from Unreal Engine 4.22, ensuring smoother performance.

This update is our way of saying [b]thank you to all the players who have joined us on this interstellar adventure over the years.[/b] Whether you’re a seasoned astronaut or a new recruit, we hope this update rekindles your love for the game and reminds you of [b]the wonder of exploring the unknown.[/b]

So, suit up, power up your thrusters, and prepare to dive back into the breathtaking world of [i]Detached.[/i] [b]The stars are calling, and your ship is ready [/b]🌌

notes.title: Detached Major Update #05 – Valve Index Supported!
notes.content:
[i]No calibration needed – we’ve heard you and did what we promised. The latest update to Detached brings a lot of news in terms of steering and compatibility. Read more below:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11726899/f685df58e4ce7ca2fe2fc11cb30b0a0fd0f96266.png[/img]

[h3][b]Added Valve Index suport[/b][/h3]
First of all, we’ve added the Valve Index support many of you were asking for. The Valve Index Knuckles controllers are now fully supported. This means you don’t have to force it to be identified as a different set of VR devices just to make it run properly.

[h3][b]Redesigned onboarding sequence[/b][/h3]
A new onboarding sequence is designed to brief players about the game's possible controls and movement options. So yeah, basically, we’ve made a better and more clear tutorial to help players choose the best movement settings that suit their style.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/s8bc6YBFjLryc2b0wN/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Added binding graphics in options[/b][/h3]
Some of you made us aware that the controls are not as clear as we hoped, so we've added some graphics with the layout of the control settings to be previewed in the options.

[h3][b]Added action names in SteamVR binding settings & localized them properly.[/b][/h3]
This required a fix, and these actions are now displayed correctly. We've made sure they are well-localized and unified so it won't cause any confusion.

[h3][b]Fixed disabling pause menu with left thumbstick[/b][/h3]
It's what it is. You can exit the pause menu by simply pressing the left thumbstick. This might become handy when you accidentally enter the menu and want a quick evacuation route. 😉

[b] It's been a long journey, but the wait is over – you can now fully appreciate the feeling of being alone in Space! See you out there, astronauts![/b] Next week, we will have a little surprise for you. Be sure to follow us to not miss the announcement!

notes.title: Telefrag VR is available now! Let's get to fraggin'!
notes.content:
Gladiators, the wait is over!

[b]Telefrag VR[/b] is now available on [i]Steam Store[/i], [i]Oculus Store[/i], and [i]PlayStation Store[/i]. Make sure you have what it takes to become a space gladiator. Prepare your VR headset and one of the supported controllers (from[i] Touch Controllers[/i] to [i]3dRudder[/i] and [i]PS Aim[/i] (coming soon)!) In case if you still wondering, here's the new Telefrag VR Launch Trailer. Check it out! :) 

[h1][b]WATCH TELEFRAG VR LAUNCH TRAILER[/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/_oqqPjjnvCo

[b]Compete on 5 unique arenas:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3416441791721215769]The Fallen Champion[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1790650479305621608]The Mobius Villa[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3238563562763926826]The Lazarus Grotto[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1584619034834529250]The Imperial Shipyard[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1587997910857016161]The Six Leagues Under[/url]. Each of them will give you a completely different experience, but above all, many challenges. We put in your hands a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1587997910828357719]Particle Cannon[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1586870199334744792]Laser Pistol[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1716342347265826513]Plasma Rifle[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1716342347256803087]Flak Cannon[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1760253077595727194]Rocket Launcher[/url]. Pick the best loadouts, conquer the enemies, and finally make a name for yourself - [b]The Champion.
[/b]

[h1][b]TELEFRAG VR MAIN FEATURES[/b][/h1]

For those who are not following our news, here's the short brief, what are the core features of the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/7c157820a99999992c7e2e37891f38750a1d3ad2.jpg[/img]

Telefrag VR is set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed and instead consolidated its power on earth and continued to expand into outer space. The conquering of new systems and races, and development of new technologies ushered in a new era of gladiator battles. 

•	[b]Loadout Management[/b] – Players have a chance to utilize different loadouts, each containing two weapons. Every weapon features two firing modes and a unique teleportation attack.

•	[b]Teleport Attacks and Telefrags[/b] – Teleporting allows players’ contact weapons to inflict “Melee Damage” as they shift from one point of the arena to the next, adding an extra layer to the standard teleport mechanic used in VR.

•	[b]Guns[/b] – Projectile weapons inflict “Ranged Damage” upon the target. The game features well-known classic arena shooter weapons.

•	[b]Fast-Paced matches[/b] – You have two different locomotion types at your disposal. Get comfortable with dash movement or experience, why gladiatorial battles are reserved for the most persistent ones in the free locomotion.

•	[b]Impossible Spaces[/b] – Walkable surfaces can be placed regardless of gravity, allowing the player to travel on any designated surface regardless of its rotation and position relative to the “real” floor. This enables multiple angles of attacks and passages through play space, and as a result a fresh take on competitive level design. 

•	[b]Arena Game Mode[/b] – A 1v1 gameplay mode where the player enters an arena with 5 weapons ready to pick. Choose two of them to compose the best loadout.  We put in your hands (both hands actually) a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games. 


[h1][b]NEED SUPPORT? WANNA PLAY? CONTACT US[/b][/h1]

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/4o111Ym.jpg[/IMG]

In case of any problems with the game, feel free to contact us, using [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/916100/discussions/1/]Steam forum [/url][/b]or our [b][url=https://discord.gg/xT8nQJ7]Discord channel[/url][/b]. We'll try to investigate the incoming bug reports as soon as possible. Also, make sure that you're on the loop, 'cause our team is ready to rock with you on [b]Telefrag VR[/b] arenas! You will find all the details on Discord.

In behalf of the whole Telefrag VR Team, we hope that Telefrag VR succesfully inject some classic arena shooters vibe to the virtual reality. [b]Let's Get to Fraggin'! [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z32drG7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Telefrag VR - We're staying on crossplay path. Win a key for the game!
notes.content:
Hi there!

We would like to share with you more news about our upcoming PvP Arena Shooter - [b]Telefrag VR[/b]. We decided to add the [b]Cross-platform PvP Multiplayer[/b], which means that players can find their opponents, between different devices. Owners of [i]Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, PlayStation VR[/i], and [i]Windows Mixed Reality[/i] devices will be able to compete with each other in places scattered around the Galactic Roman Empire.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/be3bc61db373662a4589e2ea7aba97bf7d0a6f4a.png[/img]


[h1][b]Telefrag VR with Cross-platform PvP Multiplayer[/b][/h1]

Three main reasons why we made such a decision:

• [b]Faster matchmaking [/b] - We know that multiplayer games are best played when there are many players in it. Everybody hates waiting for a long time in the lobby.

• [b]Friends[/b] - We didn't want to cut you off from friends just because they chose a different platform to play.

• [b]Equality[/b] - VR also eliminates one of the most common arguments against crossplay: keyboard + mouse are giving a significant advantage. Not here. Last week we revealed new locomotion type in the game - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1597000763095900919]Smooth locomotion[/url]. Answering your questions from Reddit - we ensure you that both locomotion types ([i]Dash & Smooth[/i]) will be balanced in terms of potential advantages of using one of the mentioned types.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/6ab2d03cdca194ff80bf86f916a744e491e91ff3.png[/img]


[h1][b]Answer the question, win Telefrag VR key [PC][/b][/h1]

[b]Tomorrow, Detached is turning 2 years![/b] That is a great occasion to make quick contest and give you Telefrag VR Key. What should you do to receive key? Just answer one question: [b]On which platform and why do you choose to play Telefrag VR?[/b]

The most interesting answer here on Steam will be awarded the code (We will send the key during the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/436230/Detached/][b]Telefrag VR[/b][/url].  launch - mid 2019)

notes.title: Let us introduce our new VR game - Telefrag VR
notes.content:
Hi!

We hope that your... not exactly peaceful journey through the abandoned space station is filled with some awesome impressions in weightlessness conditions. Since [b]Detached[/b] PS VR release, our studio has begun the new project. And yes, again, we're focused on making unique VR experience!

We love space environment so much, that we decided to stay there just a bit more. Because everyone loves space, right? :) 


[h1][b]Telefrag VR - Dare you enter the arena?[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/916100/header.jpg?t=1535695470[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/]Telefrag VR[/url][/b] is a [b]dynamic PvP multiplayer arena shooter[/b] set in alternative universe, where the Roman Empire never collapsed. Despite the advanced development, the Empire remembers its history and traditions, including the most spectacular and prestigious ones - [b]Gladiator Games[/b].
You take on the role of a new breed of a gladiator on your road to becoming the champion. Use your speed, aim, and wits to outmaneuver and defeat your enemies on the abstract arenas.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/g0KB5dnVhE2X8CMgoK/giphy.gif[/img]

Pick one of the futuristic weapons, including the one and only [b]Teleport Gun[/b]. This little buddy can not only help you move quickly to another place, but it will also serve you as a powerful weapon. If you remember the classic arena shooters from the turn of the century, you will definitely know what "Telefrag" stands for! Grab health and armor pickups placed on the map, use portals to pursue your enemy, and become a legend in the most popular games in the universe.

[h1][b]Pre-Alpha phase; The new map[/b][/h1]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11726899/848d4ad96325dfcc5d89321f5084547f0b002527.jpg[/img]


The first official information about [b]Telefrag VR[/b] was revealed during last year's [i]Gamescom[/i] in Cologne, Germany. Back then we presented the Pre-Alpha version, and we tested the first implemented features. Received feedback from the players defenitely help us improved the gameplay flow, so we're very excited and can't wait to reveal all the new features that evolved since Pre-Alpha phase. Among other improvements, we finished the first official map - [b]Fallen Champion[/b]. This is a monument to a long-forgotten champion of people erased from the history books. The now crumbling Fallen Champion is an arena that attracts fans of gladiatoral games from all around the universe.


[h1][b]Keep up to date and add Telefrag to your Steam Wishlist![/b][/h1]

We would like to invite you to follow the development stage of the game and add Telefrag to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/]Steam Wishlist[/url][/b]! The premiere is scheduled for [b]mid-2019[/b]. Telefrag VR will be available on the most popular VR devices. Stay tuned! 

Cheers,
[i]Telefrag Dev Team[/i]

notes.title: Detached - New Level - Epilogue (Enemy Land)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4RW5lOA.png[/img]

Hi! 

Friday is the best day to reveal more details about the upcoming level which will appear in Detached on all supported devices on [b]6th July[/b] (along with the PlayStation VR and Steam non-VR version launch). Exactly, if you don't know yet, in Detached you will be able to play without the use of VR goggles, and also to face your opponent in two multiplayer modes thanks to the cross-platform PvP.

One of the new features will also be an additional map in single player mode, which will extend gameplay time by [b]additional 30 minutes[/b]. Check more details below. Where will you fight for survival this time?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vm6Vdli.png[/img]

When, after great hardships, you managed to reach the rescue capsule and set up a safe course, you thought that you could breathe a sigh of relief from all dangers. For your misfortune, someone decided to solve the conflict and seize your tiny capsule, closing you into a trap.

[h1][b]Hot Pursuit[/b][/h1]

Like Tantive IV trapped inside huge Imperial I-class Star Destroyer, your task will be to escape from the enemy ship, which is bristling with dangerous watchtowers. The turrets instantly detect movement and launch a series of homing missiles in your direction. A hard nut to crack, right?

In addition to dealing with them, you have to travel inside the spaceship to disable the hatch blocking field. To do this, you will take a cheerful walk to the Reactor Core, which is the heart of the enemy ship. Seems like an easy job, but trust me, it isn't.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fdS2hS5o8ks5cgkzf5/giphy.gif[/img]

You have two options. I won't tell you which seems more reasonable, but... sometimes it's better to take a risk. It depends on you whether you like to enter into conflicts like guys from The Expendables a or avoid the threat from far away, trying to remain imperceptible to hostile sensors.

The map, which is also an epilogue, will show you an alternative end to the single player story. It will also be available for players who do not have VR goggles from July 6. So... it's time to make some chaos in space, huh?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nmwa8pz.png[/img]

notes.title: New game mode in Detached available on September 1st!
notes.content:
The release of the new update is scheduled for [b]September 1st[/b]. Challenging space races at the edge of space rim, modified multiplayer lobby and community rankings are coming to [b]Detached[/b]!

Master the controls of your advanced EVA suit and challenge other players for the risky chase. Your victory in Race mode will depend on your experience and tactics. Be vigilant, because your rival can take advantage of the acceleration to fire forward at any moment. Built-in self-guided missles will help you catch up by immobilizing your opponent for a few precious seconds.

Stay tuned for more informations in the upcoming days! We invite you to discuss the upcoming mode on the forum.

notes.title: Detached is available now! [Full Release]
notes.content:
It's happening! [b]Detached[/b] launches today on the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift!

[h1]Watch Official Launch Trailer[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGecTrjiRh0

[i]"How can you avoid sickness in VR? Well, there are a couple of solutions… but the most important are having an iron stomach and the stamina of a hardcore player. Are you one of the few who can endure the challenges of hyper-realistic virtual space?"[/i]

The extremely atmospheric environment allows you to experience the intense immersive feeling that comes with VR devices, giving you extraordinary sensations. On top of that, players using the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift can count on full controller support, further enhancing the gameplay experience.
Challenge a friend to Detached’s PvP mode and have fun outsmarting them! This variation on the popular capture-the-flag mode will test your control skills and challenge you to outwit your enemy with the advanced abilities of the EVA suit.

[list]
    [*]The game features English, German, Polish and French localization (texts) and offers controller support for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.
    [*]Several control systems are available for each controller; The arcade mode includes a flight assistant, and for even greater convenience you can enable soft collisions to correct your flight path and avoid collision.
    [*] Single-player mode has been enhanced with the new levels and features, which were not available in Early Access.
    [*]  Multiplayer mode will also receive an additional map, short after the game release
[/list]
Stay tuned for more updates. Enter The Space now! 

---

We invite you to ask questions in the forum and share your experiences with the game. Also in case of problems publish new thread in Technical Support section.

[b]Once again we remind you that Detached is an extreme VR experience that simulates sudden and dramatic acceleration, freefalling, twisting, and rolling. Even at 90 fps, it is not for VR-sensitive players![/b]

notes.title: Detached is available now! [Full Release]
notes.content:
It's happening! [b]Detached[/b] launches today on the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift!

[h1]Watch Official Launch Trailer[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGecTrjiRh0

[i]"How can you avoid sickness in VR? Well, there are a couple of solutions… but the most important are having an iron stomach and the stamina of a hardcore player. Are you one of the few who can endure the challenges of hyper-realistic virtual space?"[/i]

The extremely atmospheric environment allows you to experience the intense immersive feeling that comes with VR devices, giving you extraordinary sensations. On top of that, players using the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift can count on full controller support, further enhancing the gameplay experience.
Challenge a friend to Detached’s PvP mode and have fun outsmarting them! This variation on the popular capture-the-flag mode will test your control skills and challenge you to outwit your enemy with the advanced abilities of the EVA suit.

[list]
    [*]The game features English, German, Polish and French localization (texts) and offers controller support for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.
    [*]Several control systems are available for each controller; The arcade mode includes a flight assistant, and for even greater convenience you can enable soft collisions to correct your flight path and avoid collision.
    [*] Single-player mode has been enhanced with the new levels and features, which were not available in Early Access.
    [*]  Multiplayer mode will also receive an additional map, short after the game release
[/list]
Stay tuned for more updates. Enter The Space now! 

---

We invite you to ask questions in the forum and share your experiences with the game. Also in case of problems publish new thread in Technical Support section.

[b]Once again we remind you that Detached is an extreme VR experience that simulates sudden and dramatic acceleration, freefalling, twisting, and rolling. Even at 90 fps, it is not for VR-sensitive players![/b]

notes.title: Content Update #3 is live now!
notes.content:
The third content update for Early Access includes long awaited support for [b]Oculus Touch[/b] controllers. Put down your gamepad on the side and feel even greater immersion during space exploration! We also spent a lot of time with collision system, which has been greatly improved. Referring to the discussion on Steam about other version of the game than on Oculus Store, there is no difference in gameplay. Content Update #3 aligns both versions into one number.

Please keep in mind that we expect your feedback! You can reach us directly on Steam or [url=https://www.facebook.com/DetachedGame/]Facebook[/url] page. Enjoy exploring the outer space! :)

- Added Oculus Touch support
- Added smooth collision system
- Added auto performance optimization
- Added engineer model in MP mode

[b]Minor:[/b]
- Added checkpoint list
- Player collision tweaks 
- Visual suit damage
- New resources models
- Game tutorial changes
- Now room in HUB 7
- Graphics optimatizations
- Added loading screens

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
- Fixed environment pop-up after streaming
- Fixed no sound issue after level restart
- Fixed subtitles visibility
- Various minor bugfixes

notes.title: Content Update #1 is live now!
notes.content:
We have just uploaded our first content update, looking forward to you feedback, especially on Vive controls!

Major:
- Vive Controllers support
- New HUB – “Power inverter”
- New steering schemes and controls tweaking
- New HUD element showing current velocity vector

Minor:
- Framerate optimization
- Steering schemes are no longer bound to game difficulty
- Tutorial tweaks
- Tweaks of the forces in the accelerators
- Power relay race balancing
- Power relay now has a checkpoint
- New materials and textures on player model
- Added the exterior of the last (sixth) HUB on the map
- Added new asteroid field on the map
- Switched to Unreal version 4.13

Bug fixes: 
- Voice messages after being disrupted now properly activate
- NAND quantity now properly saves
- Fixed occurrences of debug subtitles on HUD
- Fixed the infinite "Use" tutorial
